card.name: Digits inside section numbers and codes
card.fires_on: A single digit that starts or sits inside a numbered code, such as a label section cross-reference like (6.1), an enzyme name like P450 2C9, or a model number. The digit is followed by a decimal point or a letter or more digits.

modes.label: Label section cross-references
modes.description: First digit of a section number in brackets after a section title, such as Adverse Reactions (6.1).

modes.label: Enzyme and virus codes
modes.description: A digit inside a biological name, like cytochrome P450 2C9 or HPV 6.

modes.label: Model and part numbers
modes.description: A digit within an equipment designation or a list of numbers outside medicine.

card.plain: It lights up on a digit that begins a numbered reference, such as a label section number or an enzyme code.
